programme.title: Jai perdu ma tête à Vegas
programme.desc: La mère de Sam a été arrêtée à Las Vegas. Sam va devoir trouver deux mille cinq cent dollars pour payer la caution. Toute l'équipe part donc pour Vegas.

programme.title: Sauvez Carly
programme.desc: Sam retrouve Dana, une amie qui vient de sortir de prison. Elle présente Carly à cette amie, qui l'invite à une fête. Carly se rend à cette fête, mais les relations avec Dana restent difficiles du fait de leur caractère.

programme.title: LAmérique sous le choc
programme.desc: Jimmy Fallon est fan d'icarly... Ils les invitent dans son émission télévisée... Quelle chance ! Oui... mais pas de chance ! Gibby perd son pantalon devant le monde entier ! Et ça coûte cher.... 500 000 dollars ! Heureusement que Jimmy est là !

programme.title: LAmérique sous le choc
programme.desc: Jimmy Fallon est fan d'icarly... Ils les invitent dans son émission télévisée... Quelle chance ! Oui... mais pas de chance ! Gibby perd son pantalon devant le monde entier ! Et ça coûte cher.... 500 000 dollars ! Heureusement que Jimmy est là !

programme.title: Des amis pour Spencer
programme.desc: En faisant la liste des invités pour l'anniversaire de Spencer, Carly et ses amis se rendent compte qu'il n'a pas d'amis de son âge. Ils se donnent alors pour mission de lui en trouver.

programme.title: Le vol
programme.desc: Sam a perdu son ordinateur portable. Carly et Freddie tentent de l'aider à le chercher. Spencer retrouve des tickets du Funk E. Fester's et décide de remporter le plus gros lot, Murray, le dauphin magique.

programme.title: Au revoir -- Première Partie
programme.desc: Carly doit aller au bal avec son père, mais celui-ci ne peut pas. Elle demande à Spencer de l'accompagner, mais il est malade.

programme.title: Au revoir
programme.desc: Carly doit aller au bal avec son père, mais celui-ci ne peut pas. Elle demande à Spencer de l'accompagner, mais il est malade.

programme.title: Que le spectacle commence
programme.desc: Carly est accusée pour une des sottises de Sam. Madame Briggs leur fait alors organiser les essais pour les nouveaux talents. Avec l'aide de Freddie, ils filment les auditions.

programme.title: Jadore Jack
programme.desc: Carly craque sur un garçon à l'école nommé Jake. Il est cool et sexy. Puisqu'elle l'aime bien, elle l'invite à auditionner sur son site. Malheureusement, elle comprend un peu tard que Jake est le pire chanteur du monde !

programme.title: Recherche Téléspectateurs
programme.desc: Carly et Sam se battent contre Freddie et Spencer pour décider de qui aura le meilleur plan pour rameuter les foules sur iCarly. La situation dégénère quand tous leur plans tournent à la catastrophe.

programme.title: Nevelocity
programme.desc: Carly, Sam et Freddie veulent qu'une critique de leur émission soit faite sur "Nevelocity", un site très populaire qui poste des critiques sur d'autres sites et émissions en ligne.

programme.title: Carly veut rester avec Spencer
programme.desc: Le grand-père de Carly et Spencer leur fait une visite surprise. Il est préoccupé par le fait que Spencer soit trop irresponsable et fainéant pour être le tuteur de Carly.

programme.title: Espionnage
programme.desc: Carly décide de faire une émission montrant ce que font les méchants profs quand ils ne sont pas à l'école. Elle décide de suivre son prof principal, Miss Briggs, mais se retrouve piégée avec Freddie dans l'appartement de Miss Briggs.

programme.title: Fabuleuses Aventures à Oz
programme.desc: La jeune Dorothée part pour le monde de OZ avec un groupe d'amis.

programme.title: La petite princesse et le dragon
programme.desc: Le jour de ses 7 ans, la Princesse Barbara découvre un livre magique qui la transporte dans un univers merveilleux rempli de créatures fantastiques.

programme.title: Au Secours ! J'ai rétréci mes amis
programme.desc: Pour protéger ses objets magiques, Otto Leonhard a enseigné à Félix l'art secret du rétrécissement. Ses amis ayant failli gâcher son rendez-vous avec Mélanie, Félix les réduit instantanément à un dixième de leur taille.

programme.title: Tom Sawyer et Huckleberry Finn
programme.desc: Tom Sawyer et son ami Huckleberry Finn s'embarquent pour une incroyable aventure sur le fleuve Mississipi, se prenant pour des pirates, assistant à leurs propres funérailles puis devenant témoins d'un meurtre.

programme.title: Dummie la Mommie et le Sphinx de Shakaba
programme.desc: Bien décidée à devenir célèbre, Dummie la momie peut compter sur l'aide de son meilleur ami et de son père. Un jour, ceux-ci apprennent l'existence d'une petite statuette en or représentant un sphinx qui a le pouvoir de transformer Dummie en être humain.

programme.title: Le Commando
programme.desc: Un agent de la DEA doit protéger sa famille contre un criminel, récemment libéré, et ses hommes à la recherche d'une cachette où des millions de dollars seraient dissimulés : au sein même de la maison de l'agent...

programme.title: Trigger Point
programme.desc: Nicolas Shaw fait partie d'une équipe d'élite secrète qui élimine les pires tueurs du monde. Après avoir été accusé de l'assassinat d'un membre de son équipe, il doit laver son nom et empêcher le meurtre des autres agents...

programme.title: Crazy Fist
programme.desc: Lorsque son frère est tué dans un tournoi de boxe clandestin, Shanghai n'a d'autre choix que de s'associer avec un indic de la police pour investiguer sur sa mort. C'est ainsi qu'il va tomber sur un vaste complot…

programme.title: Andron
programme.desc: Un groupe de personnes se réveille dans le labyrinthe noir d'Andron. Ils ne se souviennent plus qui ils sont et comment ils se sont retrouvés là. Ils doivent alors déchiffrer des codes, comprendre des signaux et vaincre les défis de cet endroit.

programme.title: Fausse piste
programme.desc: Hongrie, années 60. Après une série de meurtres, Martfű est sous le choc. Un innocent est condamné, tandis qu'un tueur psychotique rôde. L'inspecteur, sous pression, doit vite résoudre l'affaire.

programme.title: King rising 3
programme.desc: Hazen Kaine, ex-tueur à gages, accepte une dernière mission avant de se retirer. Mais tout dérape, et il se retrouve au temps médiéval, forcé d'affronter chevaliers et dragons pour survivre.

programme.title: Extraordinary Tales
programme.desc: Cinq histoires, cinq ambiances graphiques différentes, grâce auxquelles les artistes ont exprimé au mieux la complexité et la noirceur de l'univers d'Edgar Allan Poe.

programme.title: Kidnapping Mr. Heineken
programme.desc: En 1983, Henry Heineken, petit-fils du fondateur de la marque, est kidnappé avec son chauffeur. Les ravisseurs demandent une rançon record de 35 millions de florins.

programme.title: Le quatrième pouvoir
programme.desc: Paul Jensen, journaliste à Moscou, accepte une offre de Katja. Accusé de terrorisme, il se retrouve piégé dans un engrenage infernal.

programme.title: Rocambolesque
programme.desc: Au milieu du XIXe siècle, face à un éditeur qui refuse obstinément de l'augmenter, que peut bien faire le jeune auteur Ponson du Terrail… si ce n'est mettre dans la balance le destin de Rocambole, le héros de son feuilleton quotidien ?

programme.title: 2 minutes 30
programme.desc: Syrie, 2011. Nour passe le soir de Noël dans un appartement d'Homs avec un groupe de journalistes. Cette jeune pigiste française manque d'argent et veut sortir pour travailler. Mais dehors, c'est la guerre

programme.title: Trop de bruits qui courent
programme.desc: Evry, novembre 2015, quelques jours après les attentats de Paris. Ryad, seize ans,« n'assume pas » sa copine Sabrina: il a honte de se montrer amoureux devant ses copains du quartier. Le vol d'une vidéo sur son portable va pourtant le pousser à changer.

programme.title: Belle à jamais
programme.desc: Ville : Yaoundé. Adresse : Etoudi, carrefour du palais. C'est en arrivant dans cette maison où j'allais vivre pendant cinq semaines que j'ai décidé de filmer ses habitants : Dolvie, Daniella, Gaelle, Mirabelle, Raphaella, Ingrid, Sophie et Loic. Tous vivent chez Honorine, mais seule Gaelle est sa « vraie » fille. Pourtant ici, tout le monde appelle Honorine « maman ».

programme.title: La table
programme.desc: Un menuisier perfectionniste est obsédé par l'idée de créer un objet idéal.

programme.title: Petit homme
programme.desc: En plein nuit, Marc part furieux au volant de sa voiture.

programme.title: Iceberg
programme.desc: M. Elys travaille depuis vingt ans dans une patinoire où il a élu domicile. Il mène une vie sans but au volant de sa surfateuse à glace. Jusqu'au jour où il se heurte à Brie, une gamine farouche et obstinée.Il va lui ouvrir les portes de la patinoire sans se douter des conséquences.

programme.title: Ce qui nous éloigne
programme.desc: Après une longue séparation, une rencontre. Deux familles. Un enfant.

programme.title: Flirt
programme.desc: Quentin et son meilleur ami, Antoine, entrent en classe de troisième. Quentin a une copine. Chloé. Celle-ci ne laisse pas insensible Thomas, le petit caïd du collège. Le monde de l'enfance se fissure définitivement pour Quentin.

programme.title: De l'esprit d'équipe
programme.desc: Plongée documentaire au sein de “Pro Spectre”, l'entreprise de chasseurs de fantômes de Gilles et Joël.

programme.title: Taupes
programme.desc: Un groupe de gangsters est poursuivi après avoir dérobé un fabuleux trésor. Alors qu'ils s'enfoncent et s'égarent dans une mystérieuse forêt, ils deviennent peu à peu des figures légendaires...

programme.title: Mazeppa
programme.desc: Johan, un pianiste doué mais peu sûr de lui, s'apprête à passer un important concours musical. Submergé par le stress, il se réfugie dans les toilettes des filles où il fait la connaissance d'une jeune femme qui lui offre un tout autre destin.

programme.title: Elikia
programme.desc: Elikia, l'histoire d'un jeune homme accablé par son quotidien désastreux qui décide de se lancer dans la danse suite à sa rencontre avec Gabrielle.

programme.title: Levittown
programme.desc: Un jeune homme traverse le quartier résidentiel de Levittown, première banlieue américaine, animé par un monologue aux répliques familières. Non loin de là et alors que le soleil se couche, une jeune femme est confrontée à une menace invisible.

programme.title: Mon Oncle
programme.desc: Un jeune garçon passe ses vacances d'été chez sa grand-mère. Chaque matin marque le début d'une longue attente jusqu'au soir lorsque son oncle rentre du travail et lui raconte sa journée. Il faut dire que tonton n'a pas un métier comme les autres. Il est cascadeur pour la télé...

programme.title: Gangster backstage
programme.desc: A l'occasion d'un casting en Afrique du Sud, Teboho Edkins a demandé à des gangsters de mettre en scène leur propre image.

programme.title: La nuit des jours
programme.desc: Mariée à un cosmonaute alcoolique, grosse et poilue, Tzutza est une étoile qui se réveille chaque jour pour briller!

programme.title: Sur la route du paradis
programme.desc: Leila et ses deux enfants, Sarah et Bilal, ont quitté leur terre natale afin de s'installer en France. Sans papiers, et à la recherche de son mari réfugié en Angleterre, Leila, qui souhaite offrir à ses enfants une vie meilleure, tente de survivre et de les élever dans la clandestinité. Alors qu'elle retrouve enfin la trace de son époux et dispose de l'argent nécessaire, l'étau se resserre.

programme.title: La Prison
programme.desc: UN ANCIEN POLICIER CONDAMNÉ REJOINT UN SYNDICAT DU CRIME SECRET AU SEIN DE LA PRISONYu-gon (KIM Rae-won), ancien inspecteur de police tourmenté, est incarcéré pour un délit de fuite. En prison, il découvre que tout l'établissement est contrôlé par un détenu nommé Ik-ho (HAN Seok-kyu), qui dirige un syndicat du crime avec l'aide du directeur et des gardiens, leur fournissant ainsi l'alibi parfait. Rapidement, Yu-gon devient un membre clé de l'empire criminel d'Ik-ho.

programme.title: La Planète Des Requins
programme.desc: Dans une futur proche, la glace a recouvert 98% de la Terre. Les requins dominent désormais la planète...

programme.title: L'Apocalypse
programme.desc: Alors qu'un astéroïde menace de s'écraser sur la Terre, Jason et Ashley recherchent en vain leur petite fille disparue. Face à la panique qui s'empare de la population, ils doivent garder la tête froide car leur temps est compté. Réussiront-ils à la retrouver saine et sauve avant la fin du monde ?

programme.title: It Came From The Desert
programme.desc: Les fourmis sont les véritables vedettes de ce buddy-movie qui rend un hommage direct aux films de monstres des années 50. Inspiré du cultissime jeu vidéo des années 80 It came from the desert ce film déjanté est un fabuleux mélange de fourmis géantes et de courses de moto dans le désert… Nouveau Mexique - Se rendant à une Keg Party où la bière coule à flots nos 2 coureurs de motocross vont faire une rencontre inattendue en tombant par hasard sur un ancien site militaire. Des expérimentations secrètes visant à croiser leur l'ADN avec des débris d'une métérorite trouvée en 1951 ont été menées sur des fourmis et araignées….et qui ont donné naissance à des fourmis géantes mutantes !

programme.title: Cross Of Fire
programme.desc: L'histoire de l'ascension et de la chute du leader du Ku Klux Klan des années 1920, D.C. Stephenson.

programme.title: Le lit conjugal
programme.desc: À quarante ans, Alfonso épouse la pieuse Régina. Mais son désir insatiable épuise rapidement Alfonso. Lorsqu'elle tombe enceinte, il est mis à l'écart, contraint de vivre loin d'elle et de ne plus la déranger.

programme.title: Ratchet Et Clank
programme.desc: Ratchet et Clank unissent leur force, intelligence et courage pour lutter contre le maléfique Drek qui veut détruire la galaxie. Avec l'aide des Rangers Galactiques ils vont se lancer dans une aventure spectaculaire ! Ce duo de choc est basé sur la franchise des jeux vidéo Ratchet & Clank de Sony, qui a été écoulée à plus de 13 millions d'exemplaires à travers le monde.

programme.title: The Midas Touch
programme.desc: Drame sur un garçon de 12 ans qui rêve d'avoir assez d'argent pour pouvoir soigner la grave maladie cardiaque de sa grand-mère. Lorsqu'il se retrouve dans une maison hantée, le mystérieux propriétaire lui « accorde » un vœu : la touche Midas. Le garçon apprend vite que c'est plus une malédiction qu'une bénédiction lorsque tout ce qu'il touche se transforme en or.

programme.title: Ennemis rapprochés
programme.desc: Après un affrontement avec la police britannique, Frankie McGuire, membre de l'IRA, doit quitter l'Irlande pour les États-Unis. Il se cache dans une famille d'origine irlandaise, les O'Meary, dont le père, gagne sa vie en tant que policier.

programme.title: Clean
programme.desc: Clean, un homme au passé criminel, cherche la rédemption après avoir vécu une tragédie personnelle. Il dédie désormais sa vie à sa communauté délaissée et à la sécurité d'une jeune fille qui lui rappelle sa propre fille.

programme.title: Big Mommas: Like Father, Like Son
programme.desc: L'agent du FBI Malcolm Turner et son beau-fils Trent s'infiltrent dans une école d'arts du spectacle pour filles après que Trent ait été témoin d'un meurtre.

programme.title: Gunner
programme.desc: Lee Gunner, vétéran de guerre, part camper avec ses deux fils et leur oncle pour renouer avec eux. Mais leur séjour tourne mal lorsqu'ils attirent accidentellement l'attention d'un gang de motards impliqué dans un trafic de drogue.

programme.title: Ali
programme.desc: L'histoire de la vie du champion de boxe poids lourds, Muhammad Ali. Suivez les débuts du champion en tant que Cassius Clay, son ascension dans le sport et la politique, notamment son refus controversé de participer à la guerre du Vietnam ainsi que ses retours au combat notoires.

programme.title: The Dresser
programme.desc: Lors d'une nuit fatidique dans un petit théâtre régional d'Angleterre pendant la Seconde Guerre mondiale, une troupe d'acteurs met en scène une représentation du "Roi Lear" de Shakespeare. Les bombes pleuvent, les sirènes résonnent, le rideau se lève dans une heure mais l'acteur/directeur "Sir" (Anthony Hopkins) qui interprète Lear est introuvable.

programme.title: Super Héros Movie
programme.desc: Un adolescent orphelin est mordu par une libellule radioactive qui lui confère des pouvoirs surhumains dans cette parodie de films comme "Spider-Man", "X-Men" et "Les Quatre Fantastiques".

programme.title: 2 Days in the Valley
programme.desc: Si vous vous écartez du droit chemin, vous savez ce qui vous arrivera ? Pour Becky, c'est se réveiller à côté du corps assassiné de son ex-mari.

programme.title: Brazil
programme.desc: Dans un monde rétro-futuriste, un bureaucrate travaillant pour le gouvernement tente de corriger une erreur administrative mais devient rapidement ennemi de l'État malgré lui.

programme.title: Bye Bye Love
programme.desc: New York, 1963. Une chroniqueuse, dont le nouveau roman qui rejette l'amour est couronné de succès, tombe sous le charme d'un journaliste tombeur de ces dames qui décide de la séduire…

programme.title: Elektra
programme.desc: Elektra, célèbre tueuse à gages, accepte un contrat qu'elle refusera plus tard de remplir en protégeant sa cible et la fille de celui-ci de la terrible et maléfique organisation criminelle appelée « La Main ».

programme.title: Ruth Langsford On Coping With Grief & Loss
programme.desc: Broadcaster Ruth Langsford opens up about navigating divorce, grief, and the emotional reality of caring for parents with dementia. From therapy breakthroughs to the power of female friendships, Ruth shares the tools that have helped her find strength in life's most difficult moments. Fearne and Ruth compare their experiences of mum guilt, and why it's so important for young boys in particular to see the women in their life working. Ruth also reveals the sliding doors moment that led her to her TV presenting career. Content warning: this episode contains conversations about grief after suicide.

programme.title: Ashley James On Why Are Women Still Punished for Being Difficult
programme.desc: You're a bimbo. A nag. Too mumsy. Too bossy. Far from harmless words, Ashley James is clear they all work to shrink women and girls. In this chat with Fearne, Ashley recalls her first experiences of street harassment, and the way she victim blamed herself.

programme.title: Mary Berry: How Gardening Helped Me Through Grief
programme.desc: Mary Berry has been married for 60 years and says she and her husband have never had a cross word. Her secret? Do a lap of the garden before saying the thing you might regret. In this chat with Fearne, Mary shares the simple principles that have guided her life: be kind, contribute to community, and prioritise time in nature. Mary's 91, and her mum lived to 105.

programme.title: Dr Louise Newson On The Perimenopause Symptoms You're Ignoring
programme.desc: One in six women arriving at Dr Louise Newson's menopause clinic have suicidal thoughts. 92% see those thoughts reduce with natural hormones, so why are women still being prescribed antidepressants instead? Louise explains why women are being misdiagnosed with depression or anxiety when the root cause is hormonal. She walks through what the many different symptoms could look like, and how to talk to a GP about how you're feeling mentally and physically.

programme.title: Joe Locke On LGBTQ Self-Expression
programme.desc: Joe Locke was doing his A levels on the Isle of Man when Heartstopper came out on Netflix. Two days later he had 3 million new Instagram followers. Fearne and Joe share their experiences of being thrust into the spotlight as teenagers and how it's affected them mentally. He explores his fear that his success might just be a fluke and why he's so keen to prove he belongs in the industry. They discuss how vital LGBTQ+ representation like Heartstopper is on TV, and why Joe came out twice.

programme.title: Millie Gooch On Alcohol, Consent, & Hangxiety
programme.desc: Alcohol-fuelled hangxiety became so overwhelming for Millie Gooch that she decided to stop drinking altogether and founded the Sober Girl Society. Now, with an MSc in Mental Health and Addiction, she's spent years exploring our complicated relationship with alcohol and what sits underneath it.

programme.title: Joseph Fiennes on Learning to Live With Uncertainty
programme.desc: Actor Joseph Fiennes discusses why he needs creative challenges to thrive, and how doubt can become a productive force rather than a barrier. He reflects on playing England football manager Gareth Southgate on stage and television, exploring parallels between their approaches to negotiating fear and encouraging vulnerability in men.

He breaks down a lifetime of work on the Israel-Palestine conflict, explains shifts in the American and global right, and details underlying antisemitism in society and how it is deepened by crackdowns on freedom of expression.

programme.title: Old People Try Bizarre Food
programme.desc: The Old People are back, this time taking on some of the internet's most bizarre celebrity food combinations. From viral TikTok trends to A-list guilty pleasures, they try and rate Dua Lipa's Pickle Diet Coke, Channing Tatum's Peanut Butter, Jelly & Cheetos Sandwich, and Beyoncé's Banana with Ketchup. Will these celebrity creations be surprisingly delicious or completely disgusting. Our Old People give their brutally honest verdicts.

programme.title: Tom Holland vs Zendaya vs Jacob
programme.desc: Tom Holland, Zendaya and Jacob Batalon go head-to-head in the ultimate Spider-Man pub quiz. These legends put their memories to the test in a rapid-fire quiz covering their Spider-Man films. Do they know their lines, know about the franchise and even know random stills from the films? With bragging rights on the line and the title of pub quiz champion up for grabs, things quickly descend into chaos, confusion and comedy.

programme.title: We Quiz FLO On Their Own Songs
programme.desc: FLO go head-to-head in the ultimate JOE Pub Quiz. The girls put their music knowledge to the test in a rapid-fire battle featuring rounds including Guess the Legendary Song from the First 5 Seconds, Do They Know Their Own Song Lyrics and a test of their general music knowledge. Along the way, FLO take on Zara Larsson's iconic Lush Life dance, chat Ariana Grande, Rihanna and more, and things get seriously competitive as they battle it out to become the one and only JOE Pub Quiz champion.

programme.title: Did Boomers Create An Economy That Fails Young People?
programme.desc: As Britain faces a lost generation of over a million young people not in education or employment, the author of a sobering report into the epidemic, Alan Milburn, speaks to Ava about what the government need to do to put an end to the crisis in opportunities for young people.

programme.title: Gerry Adams on Palestine, a United Ireland, and His Awakening
programme.desc: Gerry Adams, one of the most significant political figures of the last fifty years, speaks to PoliticsJOE about his political awakening, Palestine, a united Ireland, and the future of Irish politics. In a conversation days before Andy Burnham's coronation and days after the burning of nationalist effigies on bonfires across his hometown, Adams discusses the necessary next steps for Burnham's government, how to quell the rise of the far-right, and how to prepare for the end of the union with Britain. Topics include Irish unity, sectarianism, the far-right and racism on the streets, loyalist paramilitaries, the Jeffrey Donaldson scandal, media bias, and his father's IRA past.

programme.title: On The Ground at CPAC GB
programme.desc: Why are transatlantic forces of the right assembling in North Greenwich? Andy Twelves investigates CPAC GB, the new offshoot of America's longstanding Conservative Political Action Conference that hopes to unite the right in the UK. Attendees range from Tories like Liz Truss and Jacob Rees-Mogg to online voices like Young Bob and nationalist influencer Angloid to Americans who have made the trip across the pond. Nigel Farage attended the second day of the conference, and other speakers included Matt Goodwin and Matt Schlapp, CPAC's chair. Watch various factions of the right, from Conservatives to the Reform and Restore curious, fight for their ideas in speaking halls and a dimly lit expo centre.

programme.title: The Impossible Football Geography Quiz

programme.title: Generational
programme.desc: Episode 2 of Generational, a series bringing together football fans from every generation to debate the biggest talking points in the game. Topics include whether the Premier League has ruined football, if players from the 60s and 70s could cope in today's game, whether Jack Grealish is better than Pelé, if the FA Cup is still a major trophy, and whether Manchester City should be stripped of their trophies if found guilty. Different generations bring different perspectives, experiences and opinions, with plenty of disagreement and passionate arguments throughout.

He upgrades Aime's wedding dress to a gorgeous bridal gown, complete with genuine ruby slippers and takes her bridesmaids out of their munchin-themed outfits, putting them into stunning, elegant dresses fit for a trip to the emerald city. programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E11
programme.desc: A series of reports by eleven-year-old Custer to his father, Major Ulysses S. Jamison, on the strange feats of magic at Tony's house results in the Major taking his son to Dr. Bellows, the base psychiatrist. Bellows tells Custer he believes his story, and asks him to keep a close watch on Tony. A policeman catches Dr. Bellows and Custer peering into Tony's window and takes them inside for identification. While Bellows is telling Tony that Custer believes he has seen them levitate, Jeannie causes him to do so. Bellows bows out, feeling he has stumbled on a top-secret aerospace project.Tony voices his nervousness to Jeannie about being spied on by Custer. When Custer disappears, Tony accuses Jeannie of turning him into nothing. Angered, Jeannie leaves. Later, when Custer comes back, having spent the day at a carnival, Tony penitently begins searching for Jeannie. He is sure Jeannie has joined a carnival act and starts a riot at the sideshow when he mistakes a veiled woman for Jeannie. Jeannie returns home and starts pulling down all the shades to outwit Custer.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E12
programme.desc: Jeannie is annoyed when Diane Rodney, a friend of Tony's, returns to town, determined to resume their old relationship. As a result, when Jeannie runs into Roger, while driving Tony's car, she accepts his invitation to dinner. Unaware that Jeannie is Roger's date, Tony instructs his friend in the fine art of courtship. Later, when Jeannie tells him she doesn't know her date's name, Tony begins to worry. When Diane arrives, Tony drags her all over town searching for Jeannie. The two couples finally meet at a nightclub. Alone with Jeannie, Tony demands she return home. Jeannie tells him she is going to listen to Roger's records.At Roger's apartment, Jeannie wards off all his attempts at romance. She leaves shortly before Tony pounds on the door looking for her. Tony points out to Roger all the mistakes he would be making if he married her. Convinced, Roger admits Tony has saved him from making a fool of himself. Jeannie is overjoyed by Tony's concern for her. Tony replies that, after all, he is only human.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E13
programme.desc: Jeannie agrees not to date Roger if Tony doesn't go out with other girls. Then Tony and Roger are assigned to escort Russian cosmonauts Major Tiomkin and Major Posnovsky during a goodwill visit. Major Tiomkin proves to be a beautiful girl named Sonya, who immediately stakes a claim on Tony. Angered, Jeannie tells Tony she is going out with Roger. Tony imprisons Jeannie in her bottle. Jeannie maneuvers the bottle into the pocket of Roger's raincoat. Roger presents the bottle to Sonya. Tony gets involved in a fracas with General Barkley and Dr. Bellows in his unsuccessful try to get the bottle back. When Sonya opens the bottle, Jeannie appears. Pointing to Sonya as her new mistress, she tells the cosmonaut she can make her every wish come true.When the plane on which Sonya is scheduled to return leaves, Tony feels her country now has possession of a decisive secret weapon. Later, dripping furs and jewelry, Sonya comes to Tony's home. She tells him Jeannie has granted her fondest desire by turning her into a wealthy American. Sonya agrees to return the bottle if Tony marries her. Tony asks a last word with Jeannie. He tells Jeannie he can't marry Sonya. Jeannie solves the problem by creating a duplicate Tony for Sonya.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E14
programme.desc: Unable to persuade Tony to marry her, Jeannie decides she needs a mother's counsel. She blinks her eyes and Mama appears. Mama assures Jeannie Tony will change his mind if he thinks Jeannie is going to marry Roger. Tony asks Roger if he has met Jeannie's parents. Then Dr. Bellows announces he has bought the lot across the street. Roger asks to meet Jeannie's parents. She produces a house on Dr. Bellows' lot. Tony sees Dr. Bellows and General Hadley approaching the lot. Responding to Tony's pleas, Jeannie makes the house vanish. General Hadley and Dr. Bellows see Tony sitting in the weeds sipping tea. Making the house reappear, Jeannie produces parents for Roger's visit.Tony comes to the house and forbids Jeannie to marry Roger. Then Dr. Bellows drives up. Seeing the house, he becomes distraught, and runs to Tony. As the house disappears again, they see Roger sitting in the weeds. The following day, Roger tells Tony he found himself wandering around a vacant lot. When he returned to apologize, Jeannie and the house were gone. Smiling at Jeannie, hiding in his desk drawer, Tony assures Roger he Will let him know if he ever meets Jeannie again.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized) S1E10
programme.desc: Endora tells Samantha that Maurice, her father, is coming to visit. Endora warns Samantha that Maurice will be furious when he learns his daughter has married a mortal. Samantha, determined to stand up to her father, gets Darrin to stay in town on the night Maurice calls. Samantha tells Maurice that her husband is in Washington. The conversation about Darrin proceeds nicely until Maurice surmises Darrin is a mortal. Meanwhile, Darrin, who has been drinking with Larry Tate, phones Samantha and tells her he is coming home. When Darrin arrives, Maurice's fury hits its peak. Al-though Maurice admires Darrin's courage in facing up to him, he makes him disappear. Samantha, expressing her love for Darrin, pleads with Maurice to bring him back. Even Endora joins in Samantha's pleas. Although he tells them it will be extremely difficult, Maurice makes Darrin reappear. Before leaving, Maurice joins his family in a champagne toast. Im-pressed by the rare vintage, Maurice feels Darrin might be one of them after all.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized) S1E11
programme.sub-title: It Takes One To Know One
programme.desc: When Darrin starts searching for a "Miss Jasmine" for his firm's perfume account, Endora seizes the opportunity to sew doubt in Samantha's mind about her husband's loyalty. The search for a beautiful model ends when Jannine Fleur arrives. Both Larry and Darrin agree that Jannine is "Miss Jasmine." Samantha learns that Jannine is a witch whom Endora has asked to captivate Darrin. Samantha warns Jannine to keel away from Darrin. Jannine, intrigued, keeps on with her original assign-ment. Darrin uses Larry Tate as his chaperone to keep him from becoming involved with Jannine. Darrin and Larry go to Jannine's apartment to discuss details of the "Miss Jasmine" campaign. Jannine doctors the drinks. Larry falls asleep and Darrin becomes amorous. Just as Darrin starts to kiss Jannine, Samantha uses her witchcraft, and Darrin appears to Jannine as a large ugly fish. When the campaign is completed, Samantha turns the picture of "Miss Jasmine" into a caricature of Jannine.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized) S1E12
programme.desc: Larry and Louise Tate have been married for sixteen years and have no children. Louise asks Samantha to go with her to an obstetrician as tests have shown she is going to be a mother. Louise tells Samantha she is afraid to tell Larry since she believes he hates children. Larry, visiting his dentist at the medical center, sees Louise and Samantha enter the obstetrician's office. Thinking Samantha is going to have a baby, he tells Darrin, but cautions him not to say anything until Samantha tells him. In a reverie, Darrin visualizes his children as little witches. He comes to with a sinking feeling. Samantha invites the Tates to dinner. Both Larry and Darrin hover over Samantha, warning her not to exert herself. Louise is all but forgotten, but makes several unsuccessful attempts to tell Larry that he is to be a father. Finally, Samantha tells Larry. He is overjoyed. Although Darrin doesn't tell Samantha about his reverie, he is reassured when she tells him she hopes they have a child who looks just like him.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized) S1E13
programme.desc: Samantha's friend, Gertrude, a nice, plain-looking girl expresses her envy of the happiness Samantha has found in marriage. Although Darrin tries to avoid getting mixed up in matchmaking, Samantha persuades him to bring Kermit, a handsome artist, home to dinner to meet Gertrude. Kermit falls for Gertrude. Although Samantha will mot admit it, Darrin suspects Gertrude is a witch and tries to break up her romance with Kermit. Darrin arranges a meeting at a nightspot for Kermit with Susan, a former girl friend. There, Samantha uses witchcraft to get Susan into an argument with Kermit. Susan storms out, unable to recall what has happened. When Gertrude arrives, according to Samantha's plan, Kermit proposes to her.

Initially a marriage of convenience, it evolves into a deep love story that changes the fate of India. The series portrays the era's wars, the complex relationships between the Mughals and Rajputs, and the political dynamics of the royal court. Akbar, raised as a ruthless conqueror, learns the meaning of love and compassion through Jodha, who despises the Mughals for their invasions. Their relationship transforms Akbar from a heartless ruler into the beloved Emperor Akbar, known for his justice and wisdom.

programme.title: Our Big Blue Backyard
programme.desc: It's summer on New Zealand's Open Bay Islands, and the local population swells. Wily octopus, foraging crayfish and darting penguins are joined by over 4,000 New Zealand fur seals. Masterful divers, they successfully straddle two distinct neighborhoods: beneath the waves, where they play and eat – and these rocky outcrops, where they're born and mate. Mothers balance the demands of nursing pups, mating-keen males, and their own need to efficiently hunt and feed. Everyone here has new mouths to feed, including the scavenging Weka. Unable to fly nor swim, the species was introduced as food for sealers a century ago -- and has been marooned here ever since.

programme.title: Our Big Blue Backyard
programme.desc: Stewart Island, New Zealand's third largest and southernmost island, is a place of dramatic beauty and unpredictability. Here, the Pot-bellied Seahorse father has extra responsibilities, the Octopus is both hunter and hunted, and 82 Great White Sharks need to eat, too. Standing at just 30cm and weighing only 1 kg, the Little Blue Penguin is nonetheless a swift swimmer and a determined parent.

programme.title: Stork Army: Women Fighting for the Hargila
programme.desc: In South East Asia the Greater Adjutant Stork, known locally as the Hargila, is a sight to behold. But this towering bird has seen its numbers dwindling rapidly to the point of endangerment. One woman has made it her mission to save this species from extinction. Purnima Devi Burman decided she had to take matters into her own hands, with no support from the government or financial resources, she raised a team of female environmental warriors to join her fight to save the Hargilas. She christened them ‘The Hargila Army' - and this is their story.

programme.title: Sri Lanka
programme.desc: Sri Lanka stands for colourful diversity in all respects. If it's spirituality or Ayurveda you're looking for, here it is. Adventurers and nature lovers can also satisfy their needs here. No one must travel far to discover exotic worlds on this drop-shaped tropical island. "mareTV" delves into the day to day lives of the is-landers, some of whom pursue the most unusual pro-fessions: Uditha Lakmaal is a palm tree climber. He harvests the sap of the trees, known as palm wine, by climbing to the top of them. Sri Lankan stilt fishermen now actually have very little to do with fish and func-tion more as models receiving payment from tourists for acting the part. Anulawathie runs a small floating hoop business, offering car inner tubes for adults and tuk-tuk tubes for children. Different varieties of tea can be found on Herman Gunaratnes tea plantation. Just four carefully selected women are allowed to harvest the exclusive white tea grown there. Each tea leaf is cut individually from the bush by gloved hands and with golden scissors.

programme.title: mareTV: Tenerife

programme.title: Legendary Paddle Steamers
programme.desc: The paddle steamer "Skibladner" is the oldest passenger paddle steamer in the world in regular service. It has been plying Norway's largest inland lake, the Mjøsa, since 1856. The "white swan" has a melodious name, borrowed from Norse mythology. The ship "Skíðblaðnir" of the god Freyr, built by dwarves, could always have a tail wind, could be stowed in a small bag when folded and all gods in armor had room on it. The traditional ship of AS Oplandandske Dampskibsselskap does not have such fairy-tale powers, but atmospherically the "Skibladner" also transports guests to a world long gone.

programme.title: Legendary Paddle Steamers
programme.desc: Rugged coasts, untouched nature and the rough climate of the Atlantic characterize the landscape on the west coast of Scotland. In the sounds and lochs of the Scottish West, "Waverley", the last seaworthy passenger steamship in the world, appears once a year. The side-wheel steamer was built in 1947 to carry out short ferry passages on the Clyde River. Today, "Waverley" circumnavigates almost all of Great Britain. The impressive ship was sold to the "Paddle Steamer Preservation Society" in 1974 for the symbolic price of one English pound. Since then, she starts her season off the Western Isles in Scotland every year in May.

programme.title: Legendary Paddle Steamers
programme.desc: With a length of more than 1000 kilometers, the Elbe is one of the largest rivers in Europe. The river has shaped landscapes since time immemorial: geologically, economically and culturally. One of the most beautiful sections of the river - in Saxony in southeastern Germany - has been navigated by the Saxon Steamship Company since 1836. One of its most beautiful ships is the Diesbar. Its engine is considered the oldest paddle steamer engine still in use in the world, the ship is the only steamer in the fleet still powered by coal.

programme.title: Lunenburg: Where the Land Meets the Sea
programme.desc: On the east coast of Canada, a place whose name sounds strangely familiar. The small town of Lunenburg, west of Halifax, was founded in 1753 by North German immigrants. Today, the idyllic town with its many wooden houses is a UNESCO World Heritage Site. In the 19th century, Lunenburg was one of the richest towns in the British Empire, becoming prosperous through fishing and shipbuilding. Glenn Rhodenizer's family traces back ten generations directly to German immigrants. And what the Rhodenizers primarily grow on their fields directly by the sea could hardly be more typical: it is white cabbage, which the farming family processes into sauerkraut. Sauerkraut can be found in every restaurant and supermarket in this area it is the specialty of the region. The heritage of wooden boat building is successfully maintained by David Westergard. In his ancient shed, he is assembling a 20-meter schooner from four different types of local wood. Building wooden boats, he says, is like "slow food": sustainable, conscious, environmentally friendly, waste-free.

programme.title: Dream Islands Of Europe: Capri, Ischia and Procida

Perfect destinations, then, for a week's cruise along the Gulf of Naples and the adjoining Amalfi Coast to the south. There, Positano, Amalfi or Salerno as well as a handful of other mostly small harbor towns are extremely worthwhile destinations.

programme.desc: It's time again for the Dance-Off between the Big Bitty City Dance Team and the Berry Bitty City Dancers. Plum is stressed out and frazzled because she desperately wants to win. Plum shows the girls a maze of dance steps that she's choreographed in the hopes of creating a winning piece. The problem is, the contest is only 1 week away!

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Lemon is ecstatic. She races out of her salon and goes around to the other girls' houses proclaiming that she "did it!" and beckoning them to join her. They follow her back and are completely dazzled by her newest creation - Glamicures. They are brightly colored, jeweled manicures with tiny microchips inside that play songs when the wearer moves her hand. Each girl lines up to receive her new glamicure and soon there is a cacophony of color and sound.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Plum decides to hold a dance recital at Strawberry's Café Cabaret stage and sends out a stack of invitations. Strawberry tells Plum she cannot hold the recital in the Café on her chosen day because the Café is booked.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Blueberry ordered some Zippy Gro daisy seeds and planted them in her garden. She is surprised that they've sprouted in less than a day despite their descriptive moniker. Strawberry is excited to try out the new corn muffin recipe, as its level of difficulty will be a challenge for her. Strawberry follows the muffin recipe, mixes the ingredients, and double checks it.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: All of Berry Bitty City is excitedly making their way through the berry batch in search of the elusive Wanderberry. It is to be the dessert at the BerryFest Feast. Everyone is milling about searching for it on their own when Blueberry points out that the rules say the BerryFest Princess is in charge of the search. The girls turn to her for direction and she points them where she thinks the berry might be.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Finding she has some free time one morning, Strawberry visits Berrykin Bloom who is filled with excitement over his new crop of Berry Bitty fruits and vegetables his garden has never grown so much produce! He can't wait to share his new crop (the perfect bitty size) with Berry Bitty City, so Strawberry volunteers to help him transport the produce to Orange's General Store.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: All of Berry Bitty City is gathered around to watch the last snowberrykin melt. As the last bit of snow forms a puddle, a cheer goes up, spring is here! Everyone is abuzz with how to go about choosing the Princess and what her duties will be. Postmaster Bee declares the only fair way to go about it is to hold an election. Everyone agrees.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.sub-title: Nothing To Fear But Berries Themselves

But while the girls are having a hair-styling party at Lemon's salon, a malfunction at the BerryWorks causes the whole town to go dark. And Orange begins to get really anxious.

programme.title: Enkrypted
programme.desc: Nadakhan vows revenge on the ninja and NINJAGO. The ninja and Soto escape from jail, only to find out the map to the island is on Nadakhan's ship. Nadakhan discovers that Nya looks just like Delara, his long-lost love.The secret, he says, is the venom of a Tiger Widow, a rare creature that lives on only one island. The venom can slow a djinn down. Soto is the only one who knows where the island is and will only tell if the ninja break him out of jail. Meanwhile, Nadakhan has decided to return to his home realm of Djinjago, only to discover it is falling apart. The ninja's destruction of the Cursed Realm is affecting the realms connected to it. Nadakhan uses the Djinn Blade to smash the Teapot, absorbing all the spirits that were trapped there into the sword. Falsely imprisoned, the Ninja are at their lowest point, but find an unlikely friend in an old enemy. Meanwhile, Nadakhan rescues his marooned crew and gains a new perspective, along with a new mysterious plan. With the ninja imprisoned, Nadakhan uses the Realm Crystal to free his old crew. The ninja encounter Captain Soto, the first captain of the Destiny's Bounty, who tells them the story of how he originally trapped Nadakhan in the Teapot.

programme.title: Misfortune Rising
programme.desc: The Ninja are on a collision course to find the map to stop Nadakhan, they first must find him. Meanwhile, Jay makes a wish to change his future, but it could alter his past indefinitely. The ninja's search for Nadakhan's ship turns up nothing. Nadakhan's crew is struggling to handle an airship which used to sail only on the oceans. Nadakhan confronts Jay and talks him into making a wish that will win him Nya. Jay wishes that he wasn't born in a junkyard and was rich. The next moment, he receives a letter saying his father has died and he has inherited his estate. Jay rushes home to find his parents in the junkyard and finds out they are fine, but they reveal that he is adopted. Jay discovers that his real father is the actor who played his favorite movie hero. In an effort to trap the ninja, the Sky Pirates start raids all over NINJAGO City. Nadakhan kidnaps Kai, who makes two wishes, both of which go wrong. His third wish is to “make it all go away.” Nadakhan's first mate, Flintlocke, accidentally destroys the Realm Crystal and Cole steals Soto's map. The Destiny's Bounty mysteriously vanishes from the police impound yard.

programme.title: The Cloud
programme.desc: A storm is brewing over Knighton. Monstrox has taken the form of a cloud, and is raising an army of lightning infused Stone Monsters. His first target is the new Lavalands Amusement Park. Harmony reigns in Knighton as the Knights pursue their civilian lives: Lance has a TV talk show Axl is the singing chef on the show Jestro is the weatherman Clay is teaching at the Knights' Academy Macy, Ava and Merlok 2.0 travel the land in the Fortrex making sure the kingdom's defenses are ready (part of a plan she and Clay have) Aaron and his hover shield is travelling the land setting extreme records. Robin is at his workshop at the Knights' Academy doing an “independent study” – he's working on some top secret project for Merlok 2.0. It all seems excellent! We even see the Knights new vehicles – which have been optimized for civilian life (except for Clay's.) But storm clouds are brewing. Well, one storm cloud is brewing: the Cloud of Monstrox! Yes, the Book of Monsters has reconstituted himself and is now a cloud who needs a man on the ground to enact his new evil plan. He follows his old buddy Jestro as he goes across the realm on the weekends apologizing for being evil. ZAP! With one bolt of his evil magic lighting, the Cloud of Monstrox turns Jestro evil again (only this time a bit, well, too evil.) The evil duo are back together – and bring stone to life for the first time in the form of Gargoyles from the town of GHOULIA. Now they must gather the Forbidden Powers so that the Cloud of Monstrox can destroy the entire kingdom! A battle breaks out in the Lava Lands, where Lance and Alice Squires are reporting from the opening of the Cuthbert Richmond funded Lava Lands Amusement Park, rebuilt from the remains of Jestro's old HQ. Jestro and the Cloud are after something in the remains and as Merlok 2.0 sends out a call for the Knights to help Lance. Can Lance (with an assist from King Halbert in his Mech) hold-off Jestro, the Cloud and their new army of stone fighters?!

programme.title: A Little Rusty
programme.desc: The Cloud of Monstrox and Jestro unlocks a mysterious Forbidden Power. What kind ofhavoc will they unleash? And can Merlok 2.0 and the NEXO KNIGHTS make the new COMBO NEXO Powers work? The Knights finally make it to the Lava Lands – using their various new forms of transport, which are all strictly civilian vechicles – and they must regroup and learn to fight together again to face the new threat of Jestro, the Cloud of Monstrox, and their STONE MONSTERS (in this case, Stone Gargoyles.) But Jestro and his monsters beat back the knights and recover the STAFF OF MONSTROX – which was buried under the ceremonial chamber from Episode 210 (and is now the Lava Puker amusement park ride) – and they get away on Jestro's EVIL MOBILE, which he recovers from the HQ garage. Macy says this is exactly why she's been touring the kingdom preparing everyone for the next attack. The Knights have to get it together because now the entire kingdom is under threat…again. Robin decides he must upgrade the Knights' vehicles and make them more “fight optimized.” Ava and Merlok 2.0 must figure out how to use new NEXO Powers because regular NEXO Powers do make Stone monsters back into stone, but the Cloud simply zaps them to life again. Meanwhile, in the IRON MOUNTAINS, Jestro and the Cloud of Monstrox find the first of the Forbidden Powers: RELENTLESS RUST. They find the ROGUL STATUE holding the power and zap him to life. Now…they can rust those shiny knights to pieces! Ava and Merlok are attempting to use NEXO COMBO POWERS – with hilarious results – as they try to figure out how they might work. When Jestro attacks, he's able to halt the Fortrex by instantly rusting its tracks and wheels! Robin has his hands full trying to clean all the rust from the attack of Relentless Rust. As the Knights attempt to defend against Jestro, the Cloud is zapping statues to life. He hits a statue with a bolt of lightning as Clay is touching it. Something happens…Clay feels odd stiff as if rock is mixing with his body. Finally, Ava and Merlok 2.0 download to the Knights their new thing: a COMBO NEXO COMBO Power. It works! It can smash the animated statues to dust! They use it to defeat Jestro, but he and the Cloud get away with the Forbidden Power of Relentless Rust. Victory … sort of. Clay talks to Merlok 2.0…something has happened to him. What can they do? Merlok 2.0 is very concerned.

programme.title: Thunderstox
programme.desc: Jestro and the Cloud of Monstrox encounters the sculptor. He helps unleash a horde of fierce garden gnomes on Knighton. What will the NEXO KNIGHTS do against this new enemy? Will their new COMBO NEXO Powers do the trick? As Jestro and the Cloud of Monstrox head off on the Evil Mobile to 'store' the Forbidden Power in a secret location, they encounter…THE SCULPTOR. His real name is ROBERTO ARNOLDI. He's a sensitive and odd artist who has been laid off by the king (the King ordered a "smashing" statue of the Queen, and the Sculptor made a statue of the Queen literally smashing monsters. He takes everything very literally.) Jestro instructs him to make a "bad" statue that he can use to attack the knights. The Sculptor sets to work. Meanwhile, the NEXO KNIGHTS are discussing the COMBO NEXO Powers, the Forbidden Powers, and what all this means. Lance, meanwhile, decides that since his talk show career is on hold, he thinks he'll install cameras in the Fortrex and do a Big Brother-like expose show on the Knights (he decides NOT to tell the others.) Merlok 2.0 and the Cloud of Monstrox (each talking to their cohorts) explain the history of the Forbidden Powers: it's a history lesson about the WIZARDS' COUNCIL, the Forbidden Powers, and how they were stopped long ago. This visual montage leads Jestro to…MOUNT THUNDERSTROX. The Cloud of Monstrox shows him the circle of ten Standing Stones where he will insert the Forbidden Powers. "What'll happen after that?” asks Jestro, curious. "Oh, I don't want to spoil the surprise," says the Cloud. They insert the first Forbidden Power, Relentless Rust, and it locks into place on its stone. They go off to battle the Knights and collect the "bad" statue the sculptor is making. But he's made a literally bad statue…it's terrible ... garden gnomes. Like an amateur art student. And…it's not even finished. ("You can't rush bad genius!") The Knights attack with their newly modified vehicles and they succeed in destroying the Evil Mobile. They then try to use a COMBO NEXO Power, but can't…it had to be perfect to work (Ava and Merlok need to work on it.) As Jestro and the Cloud retreat, Merlok again talks to Clay about turning to stone! Merlok calls in Robin…he will need him to build something to help Clay as he becomes more and more impaired.

programme.title: Weekend At Halberts
programme.desc: Party time in Knighton! The mood is down so the King decides to throw a party. In the meantime Jestro attacks the Fortrex, but he is confronted with the new NEXO Power "The Wedgie of Doom". Clay is turned to stone and everyone is gloomy. Especially King Halbert. In order to get everything in a better mood Aaron organizes a celebration. The King wants a reenactment of Clay's heroic rescue of the Queen. He is (as usual) totally unaware of Clay's situation. In order not to disappoint him further, the Knights get a remote control for Clay's Battle suit and is thus able to “perform” as Clay. Lance is happy to exercise his acting abilities and quickly gets into the role of the uptight knight of knights. Ava is working on reinstalling Merlok 2.0 into the Fortrex with Robin. She is also preparing the Fortrex for a visit from the new Knights' Academy novices. It is a fieldtrip with Principal Brickland and Sir Griffiths with the goal of teaching the kids about these new so-called High-tech battle strategies. Not really feeling it for anything modern, it quickly turns into a regular trip back memory lane for Brickland and Sir Griffiths. This out of control excursion is an excellent moment for Jestro who is looking for an opportunity to cheer up the defeated Monstrox. Unfortunately, for Jestro, Ava is able to make Merlok 2.0 functional again, and the Novices are able to fight Jestro and his monsters off using the NEXO Power: Wedgie of Doom. It is a humiliating defeat. Apparently, this is just what the doctor ordered for Monstrox. A good laugh at someone else's expense. His evil mood is back on.

From Jawaharlal Nehru to Narendra Modi, the book reveals the lesser-known human side of India's most powerful leaders through recipes, personal anecdotes and stories from their kitchens .

programme.title: Netanagri
programme.desc: Former Finance Secretary Subhash Chandra Garg has claimed India's Q1 GDP growth is just 2.6%, not 7.8%, alleging the government revised down last year's GDP from ₹86 lakh crore to ₹80 lakh crore to inflate current numbers. Economists backing the official figure have rejected his argument, calling it a comparison of "apples and oranges" using different GDP series.

programme.title: The Lallantop
programme.desc: The death toll in Delhi's Satya Niketan building collapse has risen to 7, with rescue operations ongoing . The building owner has been arrested, and over 1,000 buildings have collapsed in Delhi in the last 3 years, claiming more than 100 lives . Meanwhile, Swatantra Bhardwaj has been sent to 14-day judicial custody, and ISRO Chairman has clarified that no privatization is taking place.

programme.title: Duniyadari
programme.desc: The UN has adopted a resolution to phase out the Mercator map in favour of the Equal Earth projection, which shows Africa's true size. The US opposed the move, while India supported it—with the caveat that all maps must accurately depict India's sovereign territory, including Jammu and Kashmir.

programme.title: Kharcha Paani
programme.desc: Gold and Silver ETFs have new trading rules from September 7, 2026, which change how prices are discovered and how price bands operate . The new framework introduces dynamic price bands, a pre-open call auction, and a more current base price to help ETF prices better reflect global bullion movements .

programme.title: Rajdhani
programme.desc: Congress has handed Punjab's election responsibility to Sachin Pilot, replacing Bhupesh Baghel who has been moved to Assam . With Satish Poonia as BJP's Punjab in-charge, the political contest is taking an interesting Rajasthan turn, while Raja Warring's central role remains uncertain . Meanwhile, Akash Anand has been replaced by his younger brother Ishan Anand in BSP, signaling a major shift in the party's succession plan.

programme.title: sehat

programme.title: UP Bulletin
programme.desc: The demolition of an alleged illegal mosque in Saharanpur's Collectorate premises has sparked massive protests after debris removal revealed a 50-foot-deep well and ancient Lakhori brick structures, with a petitioner claiming it was a temple site . Opposition leaders have alleged a hasty pre-dawn demolition without court time, leading to detentions and road blockades across western UP .

programme.title: Zero Cricket Knowledge
programme.desc: India Women completely dismantled Pakistan in the Asia Cup, bowling them out for a pathetic 55—their lowest T20I total ever—and chased it down in just 8.4 overs. Pakistan's batting collapsed from 27-0 to 35-6 in a jaw-dropping meltdown, while Sree Charani (3/7) and Prema Rawat (3/9) ran through the lineup .

programme.title: Samosa Critics

programme.title: LIVE GURBANI FROM SACHKHAND SRI HARMANDIR SAHIB, AMRITSAR
programme.desc: Live Gurbani Kirtan from Gurudwara Sri Sis Ganj Sahib on GTC Punjabi Television brings viewers a sacred spiritual experience directly from one of the most revered historical Gurudwaras of Sikhism, located in the heart of Delhi. This live telecast offers devotees the divine resonance of Gurbani Kirtan, performed by esteemed Ragis, filling homes with peace, devotion, and spiritual reflection. Gurudwara Sri Sis Ganj Sahib stands as a powerful symbol of supreme sacrifice and unwavering faith, marking the martyrdom of Sri Guru Tegh Bahadur Ji, who laid down his life for the protection of religious freedom and human rights. Through this live broadcast, GTC Punjabi Television connects Sangat across the globe to the serene atmosphere of the Gurudwara, allowing viewers to immerse themselves in Naam Simran, Shabad Kirtan, and the timeless wisdom of Gurbani. The soulful renditions inspire inner calm, strengthen spiritual connection, and spread the universal message of love, equality, and humility as taught by the Sikh Gurus.

programme.title: Gurmat Vichar
programme.desc: Katha by Bhai Sahab Pinder Pal Ji on GTC Punjabi Television presents a profound spiritual discourse rooted in the timeless wisdom of Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji. Renowned for his deep knowledge, powerful narration, and simple yet impactful explanations, Bhai Sahab Pinder Pal Ji brings Gurbani to life by connecting its teachings with everyday human experiences. Through soulful storytelling, historical references, and meaningful interpretations of Gurbani, this Katha guides the Sangat towards self-reflection, humility, and spiritual awakening. Each session offers clarity on life's challenges while emphasizing the values of Naam Simran, Seva, truthful living, and unwavering faith in Waheguru.

programme.title: Shabad Amrit
programme.desc: Shabad Amrit is a soulful devotional songs slot dedicated to the divine verses of Gurbani. The segment features a curated selection of sacred Shabads and spiritual hymns that inspire peace, reflection, and inner harmony. Designed to create a serene and uplifting atmosphere, Shabad Amrit offers viewers a moment of calm amidst daily life, connecting them with spirituality through melodious renditions and meaningful lyrics. Rooted in devotion and reverence, the slot serves as a spiritual pause—where music becomes prayer and faith finds its voice.

programme.title: Desi Beatz
programme.desc: From foot-tapping beats to soulful melodies, Desi Beatz showcases a dynamic mix of popular artists, fresh releases, and trending music videos that reflect the pulse of today's Punjabi youth. The show captures the essence of modern Punjab—where tradition meets contemporary sound—making it a perfect blend of rhythm, style, and desi swag. Designed for music lovers of all ages, Desi Beatz turns every moment into a celebration, whether it's party anthems, romantic hits, or viral sensations. Tune in to GTC Punjabi Television and stay connected with what's trending in Punjabi music—loud, lively, and full of desi energy.

programme.title: Surtaaj of Punjab
programme.desc: “Surtaaj of Punjab” is a vibrant Punjabi musical reality show on GTC Punjabi, celebrating the rich cultural heritage of Punjab through its aspiring singers. Hosted by Saira, Anmol Aulakh and Gurjeet Singh, the show features a diverse range of talent competing for the coveted title. Renowned music directors Gurmeet Singh and Jaidev Kumar (Music Director) along with celebrated singer Jyotika Tangri, serve as the esteemed judges, guiding contestants on a musical journey. Each episode is a celebration of talent, emotion, and the magic of Punjabi music.

programme.title: HOTHAT SEDIN
programme.desc: Sanjay and Deepa are in love. Sanjay is working in an office. Deepa, after post graduation, is working on a thesis for doctorate, Sanjay always presents a bouquet of flowers (rajani gandha) to Deepa. Deepa is likely to get a job of teaching at Dhaka. She requests Sanjay to accompany her to Dhaka. Sanjay Doesn's agree as he is expecting a promotion. Deepa reaches Dhaka. To her surprise she finds Navin her ex-boy friend receiving her at Dhaka station. On the journey from Dhaka station to Ira's house, Deepa remembers the time when she broke up with Navin.... Deepa ignores the strike called by Navin. Navin warns her that if she attends the classes inspite of his call for a strike it is the end of their relationship. In Dhaka Navin was all attention to her, Unlike Sanjay who was always forgetful and engrossed in his own promotion Navin was meticulous- kept his time and was all attention to Deepa. In Dhaka Deepa forgot the past and fell in love with Navin all over again... Day of Deepa's departure from Dhaka arrives, Navin has already informed Deepa that she is sure to get the job. In kolkata Deepa finds a bunch of flowers from Sanjay in her room. She pines for letter or telephone from Navin but in vain. She hears a voice- Deepa! Deepa turns - Sanjay stands of the door smilling holding a bunch of flowers. She rushes and embraces Sanjay..... Sanjay gets delighted - so you failed to get the job at Dhaka? Don's worry ... I have got promotion, now we can get married!

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.29
programme.desc: To protect Jeongi, Gwanghae arranges for a personal guard to stay by her side. When pigments needed for overglaze painting run short, Mun Saseung turns to Hwa-ryeong for supplies—drawing Gangcheon straight to her. Thanks to Jeongi's foresight in testing Gangcheon's scheme in advance, Mun Saseung successfully completes the tribute porcelain. Enraged by his failure, Gangcheon orders Mapung to kill Jeongi.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.30
programme.desc: After hearing the full truth from Mapung, Jeongi breaks down in tears before Mun Saseung, who is left stunned and shaken. Jeongi then pleads with Gwanghae to delay Gangcheon's arrest just a little longer. Confronting Gangcheon herself, Jeongi is devastated once more when he coldly declares that Yukdo is the only bloodline he acknowledges. Claiming he wishes to atone, Gangcheon summons Jeongi to Euldam's grave.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.31
programme.desc: Tailing Hwa-ryeong's men from the merchant guild, Taedo discovers the kiln where Jeongi is being held. Seizing a brief opening as soldiers pass by, he rescues Jeongi and flees with her—only to be struck by a throwing blade. Face to face with Gangcheon, Jeongi unleashes her fury, declaring that she can never forgive him for being her father. Steeling her resolve, Jeongi immerses herself in the potter's wheel and presents the finished vessel to King Seonjo.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.32
programme.desc: With the Bunwon seized by Japanese forces, Jeongi attempts to slip away to meet Gwanghae but is captured by Gangcheon. After learning the full truth from Mun Saseung, Yukdo agonizes over his choice—then ultimately releases Jeongi. Trusting that Gwanghae will drive the invaders away, Jeongi returns to the Bunwon and waits for his promise to be fulfilled.

programme.title: Miss Korea Ep.2
programme.desc: Yoon promises to fully support ViVi Cosmetics if their Miss Korea wins, so Hyung Joon, Hong Sam, and Kang Woo search for beautiful women they know. Ji Young takes Director Ma's business card and visits Queen Beauty Salon.

programme.title: Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha
programme.desc: After the resounding success of the first two seasons, EPIC Channel presents a revamped avatar of its Raja Rasoi series. EPIC Channel's Raja Rasoi series - titled Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha - stands true to its name. While the lore and love of Indian food remains just as passionate, the new season presents a discovery oriented show format that transforms table-top cooking into an exciting food lab. Featuring renowned chef Ranveer Brar, the show will take you to his retreat – an old-world bungalow basking in the laidback vibe of Goa and then along on a ride nostalgia and rediscovery both personal and culinary. Ranveer's passion for culinary art makes him a perfect fit as the host for the latest season of the food series. He has dedicated this experimental streak and passion for food to his mentor – Munir Ahmed, a quaint, ordinary yet passionate food enthusiast from the gullies of Lucknow who greatly influenced Brar while growing up in his hometown.

programme.title: Sharanam
programme.desc: Sharanam takes viewers on a poignant journey to some of the most revered pilgrimage sites in India to and highlights the traditions, practices, rituals and ideals that bring people to these holy places in search of something greater than themselves. Narrated by Bollywood actress Juhi Chawla, Sharanam showcases testimonies of personal incidents that are the bedrock of the belief, and follows the strong thread of faith that not only binds the pilgrims to their Gods, but also the nation with itself.

programme.title: Indipedia
programme.desc: A light and peppy anchor driven half-hour episodic series that explores the reasons, bellefs and logic behind the customs and rituals observed as a norm In India, often so casually that most of us have never really asked why they arethe way they are.

programme.title: Umeed India
programme.desc: If you'd imagine an ace cricketer to host a television show, you can be sure it will be a sports related series. And, Umeed India makes a compelling case. For the first time, versatile cricketer Virender Sehwag will host a television show. Umeed India will showcase groundbreaking stories of diversified, intrepid athletes aiming for glory at Olympics 2020. For the 13-part series, Virender reinstates the fact that Olympic stars never ‘just' appear at the Games. Their stories start in small villages, where they train every day – with one aim in mind – bringing home that Gold. Watch Virender travel to their training bases, chronicling exciting moments in the home environment besides interviewing the athletes' families and coaching staff. The episodes feature inspiring stories of OP Karhana, Suyash Yadav, Avtar Singh and Dutee Chand along with Sakshi Malik, Vinesh Poghat among many other Olympians. Can we find the 2020 medalists for India in 2017?

programme.desc: The Indian Army is an emotion – a living chronicle of events, that we have the luxury to forget because they remember. The army itself is a family of several regiments, each of which has its own history, identity, and glorious traditions. Regiment Diaries is a tale of the Indian Army unlike any told before. programme.desc: With the luxury saloon EQS and the sporty executive saloon EQE, Mercedes-Benz has entered a new, all-electric era in the upper market segments as well. The EQS SUV, the third model series with this architecture developed for electric vehicles, will soon follow. The SUV offers plenty of space, comfort and connectivity for up to seven passengers in its avant-garde, luxurious interior. Thanks to powerful electric motors, responsive 4MATIC all-wheel drive and an intelligent OFFROAD driving mode, the EQS SUV is also capable of tackling light terrain with ease. The new EQS SUV shares the long wheelbase (3210 millimetres) with the EQS Saloon, but is over 20 centimetres higher. The dimensions in detail: 5125/1959/1718 millimetres (length/width/height). The interior dimensions benefit from these generous SUV dimensions and from the advantages of the purpose design tailored to the electric platform. The second row of seats can be electrically adjusted as standard. Up to four golf bags fit in the boot. A third row of seats with two additional individual seats and extensive comfort features for all passengers is available as an option.

programme.title: Colour change with the power of thought
programme.sub-title: The BMW iX Flow meets neuro-technology
programme.desc: The Munich-based startup brainboost used the new and improved colour-changing effect in a one-off collaboration with the BMW Group at rad°hub aimed at raising awareness of mental health. With the help of brainboost, the BMW iX Flow was connected directly to the brain of the rad°hub delegates using an electroencephalograph (EEG), which records the brain's electrical activity. “The colour patterns of the BMW iX Flow react to brain activity and reflect the level of activity,” explains brainboost CEO Philipp Heiler. “Once the brain is at rest, the changes of patterns on the iX Flow also become calmer and more rhythmical.” A special animation was activated if delegates managed to maintain this state for several seconds. Thus, the participants were able to gradually calm and relax their brains under the guidance of the brainboost experts and with the help of neurofeedback via the iX Flow. This matures the knowledge of which strategies work best to specifically shut down one's own brain activity for relaxation, e.g. in everyday working life.

programme.title: New 2023 Range Rover Sport Design Reveal Film
programme.desc: The New Range Rover Sport has made its global premiere with a dramatic world-first climb up a flooded dam spillway in Iceland. The epic ascent saw New Range Rover Sport resist the surging torrent of water flowing down the ramp of the Karahnjukar Dam – the biggest of its kind in the world – at a rate of 750 tonnes per minute. A loss of traction risked plunging down the perilous 90m drop at the base of the spillway to the valley floor below. The successful spillway ascent was screened for the first time at an exclusive launch event at Jaguar Land Rover's Advanced Product Creation Centre at Gaydon, UK. Official James Bond stunt driver Jessica Hawkins was behind the wheel as the New Range Rover Sport demonstrated its grip, traction, performance and composure, completing the latest in a series of challenges for Land Rover's luxury performance SUV. Previous feats include a record-setting hill-climb at Pikes Peak, a first recorded crossing of the ‘Empty Quarter' desert in the Arabian Peninsula and a first ascent of the 999 steps to Heaven's Gate in China, in 2018.

programme.title: Hispano Suiza showcases its history in the Peralada Castle Museum
programme.desc: The history of Hispano Suiza is showcased, for the very first time, in the Peralada Castle Museum (Girona, Spain) where visitors will be able to contemplate the past and present of the legendary car brand founded in 1904 by Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt. The Hispano Suiza Room will close the usual tour of the Peralada Castle Museum. After years of researching to gather the largest number of pieces and objects related to its history, Hispano Suiza becomes part of this important collection. The Hispano Suiza exhibition encompasses a journey through various decades: from the beginning of the 20th century, when Hispano Suiza was founded, to the present day. After passing through a luxurious hall, the public will be able to visit a recreation of the offices of Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt, where countless business and technical ideas, emerged and took shape, turning Hispano Suiza into a point of reference, for luxury, comfort and technical solutions. In this area, the original painting 'Dame with a mink' by Ramon Casas takes pride of place: it was used as an illustration on the company's original shares.

programme.title: TechDay Digital Light
programme.desc: Safety and customer satisfaction come first at Audi. They are part and parcel of the success of the company with the four rings. In that context, light technology is steadily growing more important and creating a wider range of possibilities and perspectives, from added safety for the driver, to external communication and individualization. Systematic light digitization is making all of this possible. It is particularly visible in the new Audi A8: the forward-looking Digital Matrix LED headlights and digital OLED rear lights raise the customer experience to a whole new level: for the first time in any Audi model, light is completely digitized. The car can be individualized even further through its digital OLED rear lights. The Digital Matrix LED headlights also include three new functions: advanced traffic information, a lane light with direction indicator lights on highways, and an orientation light on country roads. These features not only demonstrate Audi's “Vorsprung durch Technik,” they also add value.

programme.title: 2022 Peugeot 308
programme.desc: The sixth generation Opel/Vauxhall Astra and third generation Peugeot 308 are both based on the Stellantis EMP2 platform and, unsurprisingly, score very similarly across all four areas of assessment. Both the offset test and the full-width crash test highlighted marginal chest injury protection for average male and small female drivers, and neither car was equipped with a centre airbag for far-side crash protection, a countermeasure which is increasingly common on modern cars. Both cars offer plenty of crash avoidance technology but do not include some of the latest advancements introduced in the market. The cars' four-star ratings apply also to their PHEV variants.

programme.title: ECO CIDE
programme.desc: In 2010, BP's Deepwater Horizon oil rig exploded killing 11 men. Over 200 million gallons of oil poured into the sea for 3 months impacting an area the size of England and Scotland combined. The first oil spills washed ashore on Grand Isle, Louisiana. Years later, while the authorities and the US government claim that the shore is completely safe, locals assert that they are still facing the effects of the world's biggest oil spill. This feature documents the impact the spill had on Grand Isle's health, economy and businesses, and how it continues to haunt them.

programme.title: THE SHARK DIVERS

While The Whale Shark Attracts A Devoted Following And You Can Now Scuba-Dive With Them In Aquariums, Is The Popularity Of The Activity Endangering The Same Sharks?

Following Five Women From The Us And Europe, It Highlights Their Fight Against Tech Giants Like Meta, Tiktok, And Snapchat, Focusing On Issues Like Addiction, Mental Health, And Exploitation.

programme.title: GREENWASHING THE CLIMATE KILLER
programme.desc: Investigating major companies like Total Energies and Nespresso, we find their carbon neutrality and net zero claims rely largely on dubious carbon offset schemes. programme.title: Changing Ocean Asia
programme.sub-title: S01:E04 - Sea Level Rise and Engineering Solutions
programme.desc: Across south-east Asia there are mega cities sinking fast. The race is on to predict how fast cities will sink. South-east Asia is a unique part of the world, featuring low-lying countries, pristine islands, and vast coastal habitats. 600 million people across the region live in low elevation coastal zones, all vulnerable to sea-level rise, flooding, and extreme weather events like Tsunamis and Typhoons.

programme.title: Survive the Wild
programme.desc: Animals or groups protect their territory by using sounds like birds singing or scents like pheromones from many mammals to mark boundaries. These are just the initial warnings. If other animals ignore these signs, a conflict might happen. Animals need a secure territory to mate, raise their young, and ensure there's enough food and resources for survival. This episode looks at the strategies animals use to claim their territory.

programme.title: Survive the Wild
programme.desc: When animals share info to help each other decide, it's called animal communication. They use stuff like sounds, colors, body language, movements, electric signs, touches, smells, or a mix of these. Whether it's a sea anemone spreading its tentacles or a male lion considering approaching a mate, their skill in communicating can be vital for their success. This episode dives into how animals interact with one another.

programme.title: Up the Dish
programme.desc: Take a trip around the world in this episode of Up the Dish! Host Missy Hui hits the Great Wall running - her Chinese Fried Rice recipe is a classic complete with crispy bacon, crunchy onions and savoury scallions. Then, Poppy Sandler sets off for the Land of the Rising Sun with Crispy Sushi Rice and Spicy Tuna sriracha mayo seasons the sushi-grade tuna and sticky short-grain rice cakes are fried (fried rice anyone?) to a beautiful golden-brown. Micah Trainor's Gorgonzola-Chive Arancini puts a Sicilian spin on frying rice - panko-crusted arborio is creamy and flavourful with blue cheese and chives for this ultra-indulgent Italian redux. Rice Papad with Turkey Tikka Masala is Tiera Singh's Indian extravaganza, taken to the top with puffy (fried, of course!) rice papad and tender braised turkey legs drenched in old school tomato-spice curry.

programme.title: Up the Dish
programme.desc: Get ready for a not-so-raw deal in this episode of Up the Dish! Host Poppy Sandler sets things in motion and slices up a simple, elegant Sashimi with tangy Ponzu and tart Wasabi Mayo on the side. Missy Hui gets carnivorous with Lamb Carpaccio and Dukkah - delicate raw lamb and a Middle Eastern-style dip served with some delicious pita! But wait, what's a vegetarian to do with all this meat? Tiera Singh's got the answer - island-style Poke Bowls, with fruit instead of fish. Refreshing watermelon is marinated in a savoury, soy-based sauce and served with rice. For the finale, Micah Trainor Up('s) the Dish with her Scallop Tartare and Beet Chips, combining raw scallops with ultra-decadent truffle oil and sour cream.
